image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a Nile crocodile's head and upper torso partially submerged in murky water. The crocodile is facing left, with its snout just above the waterline. The skin texture is highly detailed, showing rough, bony scutes. The eye is visible and alert. The lower jaw is slightly visible beneath the water surface.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers distinctly towards the nostrils, consistent with the V-shape of a crocodile rather than the U-shape of an alligator. The head structure appears anatomically correct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Several conical teeth from the lower jaw are clearly visible protruding upwards even though the mouth is mostly closed, matching the description of interlocking teeth.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is positioned on top of the skull. While the vertical slit pupil is hard to resolve at this resolution, the placement and general morphology are correct. No obvious artifact in the eye region.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The nostrils are clearly visible at the anterior end of the snout, raised slightly above the main plane of the snout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body behind the head shows thick, armored skin consistent with an elongated reptilian body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture of the skin is highly detailed, showing distinct, rough, bony plates (scutes) that appear to follow a longitudinal pattern along the back.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is a mix of greys and browns, and the texture is visibly rough and granular, matching the ground truth.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The ventral surface (belly) is submerged or out of frame; only the dorsal and lateral aspects are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The limbs are completely obscured by the water and the angle of the shot; only the head and upper back are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is not visible in this close-up crop of the head and shoulders.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The reflection and refraction of the snout in the water are slightly inconsistent. The underwater portion of the snout appears somewhat blurry and lacks the expected optical distortion clarity, blending slightly into the murky background rather than showing a sharp refractive boundary.

The transition from the lower jaw to the neck area under the water is indistinct. The anatomy seems to 'melt' into the water without a clear definition of the throat or neck muscles, which is a common AI artifact in semi-submerged subjects.
